title.en: Information theory, entropy, and probabilistic objectives
title.zh: 信息论、熵与概率目标函数

lead.en: Prove finite information identities and KL positivity, connect prediction to likelihood and decoding, and report sequence perplexity with support and scoring units stated.
lead.zh: 证明有限信息恒等式及 KL 非负，连接预测、似然与解码，并明确支撑和计分单位后报告序列困惑度。

prerequisites.en: Modules 16, 23 and 25. The optional continuous-density preview uses Module 17. Every lab is a standalone Python standard-library script.
prerequisites.zh: 需模块 16、23、25；选学连续密度预览需模块 17。各实验均为独立标准库脚本。

en: Compute surprisal with declared log units and decodable-code assumptions.
Derive finite entropy, conditional entropy and chain rules.
Connect cross-entropy to expected log loss, likelihood and qualified code lengths.
Prove KL nonnegativity and equality with zero-support conventions.
Derive mutual information and finite data processing without causal overclaims.
Report sequence perplexity with matched token units and distinguish differential entropy.
zh: 按声明 log 单位与解码条件算自信息。
推有限熵、条件熵与链式。
连接交叉熵、log 损失、似然与带条件码长。
含零支撑证明 KL 非负及等号。
推互信息和有限数据处理，不过度声称因果。
按匹配词元单位报困惑度并区分微分熵。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and derive coding and chain identities.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节并推编码与链式恒等式。
阅读信息量权重与单位。

text.en: Retrieve support and conditional averaging conventions.
text.zh: 检索支撑与条件平均约定。

title.zh: 交叉熵与 KL 证明

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and prove likelihood and divergence connections.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，证似然与散度连接。

text.en: Calculate finite entropy, support mismatch and noisy-bit information.
text.zh: 算有限熵、支撑错配与噪声比特信息。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and distinguish processing, tokens and density units.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，区分处理、词元与密度单位。

text.en: Evaluate the fixed held-out unigram model and baseline.
text.zh: 评估固定保留 unigram 与基线。

text.en: Repair probability inputs, units and token comparisons.
text.zh: 修复概率输入、单位与词元比较。

text.en: Complete choices and write an information-loss derivation.
text.zh: 完成选择并写信息损失推导。

text.en: Read coding assumptions and the optional density preview.
text.zh: 阅读编码条件与选学密度预览。

text.en: Complete the exit task and audit log-loss interpretations.
text.zh: 完成结业，核查 log 损失解释。
